Package com.composum.platform.commons.json

Class AbstractJsonRpcServlet<T extends JsonRpcInterface>

  • java.lang.Object
    • javax.servlet.GenericServlet
      • org.apache.sling.api.servlets.SlingSafeMethodsServlet
        • org.apache.sling.api.servlets.SlingAllMethodsServlet
          • com.composum.platform.commons.json.AbstractJsonRpcServlet<T>
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable, javax.servlet.Servlet, javax.servlet.ServletConfig
    public abstract class AbstractJsonRpcServlet<T extends JsonRpcInterface>
extends org.apache.sling.api.servlets.SlingAllMethodsServlet
    Deprecated.
    not yet tested
    Base class for servlets that provides in conjunction with AbstractJsonRpcClient "remote procedure calls" from a Sling server to another Sling server via the usual Sling Servlets and Gson serialization of the arguments. A description of the needed constraints is given at JsonRpcInterface.
